subject: palette
text: | seven_guis accent | `#3a5ce5` (hover `#2a4cd3`, active `#1f3fc1`) | Accent on page `#f5f5f5` with text `#1a1a1a` (examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/counter.rs:49; examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/counter.rs:59-72; examples/seven_guis/src/app.rs:183); one step darker since 2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions, the operator's choice — until then `#4a6cf7` (hover `#3a5ce5`, active `#2a4cd3`) — in every task CSS that declares it, its non-text uses moving with it and its three `rgba` uses reading `rgba(58, 92, 229, …)`, alpha kept; measured as the background of white `#ffffff` button text on the four accent controls (`counter-increment`, `flight-book`, `timer-reset`, `crud-create`, 14–16 px, weight 500, at boot): 5.47 against SC 1.4.3's 4.5, a pass — the old `#4a6cf7` read 4.39, a fail — and white on the hover shade 6.83 and on the active shade 8.27, each a reached colour state of `stand_contrast`; every measured stand colour equals its declared value (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_contrast.rs:49-132; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_contrast.rs:294-406; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-13-stand-contrast-harness/report.md and its evidence/pairs.md, the re-colour and its ratios at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions/report.md) |

text: | Field — seven_guis flight-type select | `1px solid #c0c0c0`; focused, `#3a5ce5` | The flight booker's `flight-type` select (`.type-select`) paints `#1a1a1a` on `#ffffff` (17.40, 15px 400) inside a `1px solid #c0c0c0` border; on focus it drops the outline for a `#3a5ce5` border, as the date inputs do (examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/flight_booker.rs:160-172; as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-25-cold-agent-bar/report.md) |

subject: typography
text: - The seven_guis headless stand registers the same bundled DejaVu Sans for every generic, with system fonts off, on native — `build_single_font_ctx(DEJAVU_SANS)` through `HarnessOptions.font_ctx`, for every boot, Cells' (`boot_cells`) and the load page's (`boot_load`) among them, decoded by seven_guis' native `woff` feature (examples/seven_guis/src/stand.rs:59-61; examples/seven_guis/src/lib.rs:7; examples/seven_guis/Cargo.toml:31)

subject: spacing
text: - seven_guis cards pad 24px 32px with 16px gap; home pads 48px 32px 64px (examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/counter.rs:38-42; examples/seven_guis/src/app.rs:191)

subject: depth
text: - seven_guis cards use `0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08)`; the circle dialog uses 0.10 (examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/counter.rs:43; examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/timer.rs:76; examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/flight_booker.rs:148; examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/circle_drawer.rs:210)

subject: radius
text: | seven_guis (untokenized) | cards 8px, buttons 6px, inputs 4px, task cards 6px, tags 3px, the flight booker's `flight-type` select 6px | (examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/counter.rs:41; examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/counter.rs:61; examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/temp_converter.rs:71; examples/seven_guis/src/app.rs:228; examples/seven_guis/src/app.rs:269; examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/flight_booker.rs:160-167) |

subject: desktop-native-tokens
text: - The stand's flight booker overrides those select defaults on its one select, `select#flight-type` (class `type-select`, `aria-label` "Flight type"): 15px text, `#1a1a1a` on `#ffffff`, `1px solid #c0c0c0`, radius 6, padding 8/10, and on `:focus` no outline but a `#3a5ce5` border, as the stand's date inputs do; its two options (`one-way flight`, `return flight`) show the chosen one alone by the engine rule above (examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/flight_booker.rs:66-89; examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/flight_booker.rs:160-172)

subject: desktop-native-stand-load-page
text: - The stand's load page (`seven_guis::stand::boot_load`, mounted in `TaskShell` titled "Load") holds two keyed elements, the button `load-fetch` and the paragraph `load-done` (`display: none` until its stylesheet lands); no CSS selects by id — its classes are `load-root`, `load-body`, `load-btn` (with `:hover` and `:active`) and `load-done` (examples/seven_guis/src/stand.rs:185-200; examples/seven_guis/src/stand.rs:202-244)
